title: Product of Array Except Self
kidExplanation: Each kid wants the product of everyone else's scores — not their own — and you are not allowed to use division.
plainProblem: Return an array answer where answer[i] equals the product of all elements except nums[i]. O(n) without division.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For each i, multiply everything except i. O(n²).

thinkingSteps.title: Division trick (not allowed / fragile)
thinkingSteps.body: Total product / nums[i] breaks on zeros and is often disallowed.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: answer[i] = product of left side × product of right side.

thinkingSteps.title: Better idea
thinkingSteps.body: One pass builds prefix products into the output; a second pass multiplies suffix products.

pattern.name: Hash set / hash map for seen items
pattern.whenToSpot: You need fast lookups of values you already saw.

solutions.python:
# Product of Array Except Self — interview-friendly solution from NeetCode 150 repo
# Comments explain the idea; logic is unchanged.

class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        result = [1] * n

        # Calculate the left product of each element
        left_product = 1
        for i in range(n):
            result[i] *= left_product
            left_product *= nums[i]

        # Calculate the right product of each element and update the result list
        right_product = 1
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            result[i] *= right_product
            right_product *= nums[i]

        return result

complexity.timeReason: Two linear passes over the array.
complexity.spaceReason: Output array does not count as extra space per the usual problem note; only a few variables otherwise.
